evidence_state: Acceptance evidence is generated from final frozen producer and dual-contract bytes, isolated per-set clean builds, exact retained raw-root enumeration, lossless parser reports, retained object/library bytes, and same-set closure.
containing_commit_binding: This manifest is committed in the Git commit that contains this manifest. The containing commit hash is intentionally not embedded.
self_reference_limitation: Embedding the containing commit or requiring a Full guard transcript to validate its own final hash would be self-referential. Full guard runs skip only their own changing transcript hash; staged evidence records its pre-final capture point.
independent_audit_requirement: An independent audit must obtain the containing commit from Git and verify its parent, branch, production-source scope, manifest content, referenced hashes, retained input inventories, and final clean synchronized status.
historical_binary_limitation: All evidence generated before the schema-1.5 frozen producer run is historical. Acceptance relies only on the retained schema-1.5 four-set evidence under artifacts/logs/production-orchestration-ab-tlog-provenance/.

ab_rebuild_contract.normalization_justification: A/B normalized equality is obtained only by zeroing linker timestamps, the derived PE checksum, debug-directory timestamps, and the per-build CodeView GUID. provenance_closure_contract.retained_raw_root_policy: Each set has a disjoint raw-tlogs root enumerated independently in both directions.
provenance_closure_contract.strict_parser_contract: All raw bytes and record text are retained; unparseable, discarded, and unexplained counters must be zero.
provenance_closure_contract.generated_intermediate_retention_contrac: Every generated OBJ and LIB has a set-local byte copy and SHA-256.
provenance_closure_contract.source_input_closure_contract: Every retained OBJ has exactly one primary compile source and retained CL command/read/write references.
provenance_closure_contract.generated_library_closure_contract: Every emitted project LIB is retained; the declared but non-emitted ChatpadFilter import-library path is explicitly classified.
provenance_closure_contract.same_set_closure_contract: All producer, consumer, external-identity, contamination, and unexplained-output counters are zero.
provenance_closure_contract.transcript_schema: Every set transcript binds identity, clean/build/capture times, counts, and prohibited-action counters.
provenance_closure_contract.guard_defect_counter_schema: Full guards emit all provenance, evidence, parser, closure, transcript, and safety defect counters.
